name: Omarwalls
author: hapatapa
description: Live wallpapers for Omarchy from a local store (~/.local/share/omarchy-webwall/wallpapers): GLSL shaders on a pure-Vulkan host, HTML/JS pages on a detached QtWebEngine host, and looping videos on QtMultimedia — all on the wlr-layer-shell Background layer, theme-aware from the native Omarchy colors (u_theme[] / window.webwallTheme). The service supervises the host, and the overlay is a picker in the Omarchy menu style.
